title: Charminar
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Charminar exterior:four cream-stucco minarets with stacked open galleries/corbels/bulb caps,deep four-way pointed crossing arches,open upper facade gallery/four clock faces,closed small lower fields and clerestory,sparse parapet lattice/balcony bracket rhythm and western roof cupola. Four existing shared256² graphs,five merged groups,four browser levels. Exact current controls and conflicting height/dimension facts remain distinct.
